Geographies Served Programs Project Shiksha One of the most important aspects of women's empowerment is education. Also, it contains some of the most egregious instances of prejudice against women. There are twice as many girls as boys among school-age children who do not attend, and there are twice as many women as men among illiterate adults. At Canasu, we provide scholarships for talented female students from underprivileged communities who are single mothers. Project Vridhi Through enhancing their capacity to effectively manage their own possibilities for a living and enhancing their security, we collaborate with women in the communities to increase their future prosperity. Project Vridhi aims to empower and skill women so they may support themselves and live dignified lives. By giving them skill sets that can enable them to realise their aspirations and have an impact on their community, we assist them in constructing and nurturing their lives. Also, we put a lot of effort into educating women about adjusting to new opportunities through training and organising exhibitions. Canasu attempts to emancipate women by reaching out to local communities near Bengaluru. We think that through empowering women's inner voices, they can foster a culture of achievers. We must develop their thoughts in order to let them hear their inner voice and move forward with their resolve. Women's inner voices need to be changed in order to produce lasting change that could impact communities. --> Milestones & Track Record In 2019, Canasu Dream Foundation organized a breast cancer awareness event in Whitefield. --> --> Leadership Team Moahmmed Shoaib Founder and CEO Kushal Babu Board of Director Shaikh Asif Head of Operations Neeraj Doddamane Director Rohi Huma Board of Director Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength 3 Organization Structure Yes M&E Internal, External Assessors Yes --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AACTC4345G Registration Number No: IV 342/18-19 CSR Form 1 CSR00039608 80G AACTC4345GF20221 12A AACTC4345GE20221 FCRA Not Available About Headquarters Bangalore, Karnataka Since 2019 Demographies Served Youth Women --> Impact The foundation focuses on empowering young individuals and communities to create positive social impact. Vision and Mission Vision: Our vision is to create a world in which all women determine the course of their lives & reach their full potential. Mission: ​Our mission is to support women to achieve their full potential; to encourage, enable and facilitate their active involvement in business, employment, learning and community life. We seek to achieve this by harnessing the economic power of women and communities, promoting education, skill development, social inclusion, and changing perceptions.
